PHYSICAL EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

2. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   C. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.

3. Best practice when working on Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t: (1 mark)
